description: Test suite for Kubernetes taints utility functions, including adding, updating, deleting, filtering, and diffing taints on nodes.

methods.name: TestAddOrUpdateTaint
methods.description: Tests adding or updating taints on a node.

methods.name: TestTaintExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific taint exists in a list.

methods.name: TestTaintKeyExists
methods.description: Checks if a taint key exists in a list.

methods.name: TestTaintSetFilter
methods.description: Filters a set of taints based on a predicate function.

methods.name: TestRemoveTaint
methods.description: Removes a specific taint from a node.

methods.name: TestDeleteTaint
methods.description: Deletes a specific taint from a list.

methods.name: TestDeleteTaintByKey
methods.description: Deletes taints by key from a list.

methods.name: TestCheckIfTaintsAlreadyExists
methods.description: Checks for existing taints and returns matching keys.

methods.name: TestParseTaints
methods.description: Parses taint specifications into taint objects and removal instructions.

methods.name: TestValidateTaint
methods.description: Validates taint key, value, and effect.

methods.name: TestTaintSetDiff
methods.description: Computes differences between two taint sets for addition and removal.
